claims.question: Which env var authenticates mcp-atlassian against Jira Data Center/Server?
claims.skill_answer: JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN (a Personal Access Token); no username needed.

claims.question: How many Personal Access Tokens can a single Jira Data Center user create?
What must CONFLUENCE_URL end with for Atlassian Cloud?
Which mcp-atlassian version changed the default from all tools to a core subset, and when?
claims.skill_answer: v0.22.0, released 2026-07-10; defaults to 6 core toolsets.

claims.question: How many tools did mcp-atlassian v0.21.1 expose?
What security hole did mcp-atlassian v0.22.0 close in streamable-http transport?
claims.skill_answer: Unauthenticated requests fell back to operator global credentials; now 401.

claims.question: Which env var re-enables the pre-v0.22.0 global credential fallback, and its default?
Which env var disables TLS certificate verification for Jira in mcp-atlassian?
What trust store does mcp-atlassian use for TLS by default, and how do you switch to certifi?
claims.skill_answer: OS trust store via truststore; set MCP_ATLASSIAN_USE_SYSTEM_TRUSTSTORE=false.

claims.question: How do TOOLSETS and ENABLED_TOOLS combine in mcp-atlassian?
claims.skill_answer: They intersect; unknown toolset names are silently ignored.
